name: @pipeworx/mcp-youtube

tools.name: yt_search
tools.description: Search YouTube for videos, channels, or playlists. Returns snippet info including title, description, channel, thumbnails, and publish date.

_apiKey.description: YouTube Data API v3 key from Google Cloud Console

max_results.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 50)

channel_id.description: Filter results to a specific channel ID

published_after.description: Filter results published after this ISO 8601 date (e.g. "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z")

tools.name: yt_video_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about one or more YouTube videos including title, description, channel, duration, view/like/comment counts, and tags.

_apiKey.description: YouTube Data API v3 key from Google Cloud Console

video_id.description: Video ID or comma-separated list of video IDs (max 50)

tools.name: yt_channel_details
tools.description: Get YouTube channel information and statistics including subscriber count, video count, view count, description, and custom URL.

_apiKey.description: YouTube Data API v3 key from Google Cloud Console

tools.name: yt_channel_videos
tools.description: List recent videos from a YouTube channel, ordered by date. Returns video ID, title, description, and publish date.

_apiKey.description: YouTube Data API v3 key from Google Cloud Console

channel_id.description: Channel ID to list videos from

max_results.description: Number of videos to return (default 10, max 50)

published_after.description: Filter videos published after this ISO 8601 date

published_before.description: Filter videos published before this ISO 8601 date

tools.name: yt_video_comments
tools.description: Get top-level comment threads on a YouTube video. Returns author, text, like count, and publish date.

_apiKey.description: YouTube Data API v3 key from Google Cloud Console

video_id.description: Video ID to fetch comments for

max_results.description: Number of comment threads to return (default 20, max 100)

tools.name: yt_video_transcript
tools.description: Get the transcript (captions) of a YouTube video: timestamped segments plus the joined text, the caption language, and whether the track is auto-generated. No API key needed. Use it to summarize, quote or search what is said in a video. Long videos are paged: pass the returned next_start_seconds as start_seconds to continue. A video with no captions returns a captions_unavailable error, never an empty transcript.

video_id.description: YouTube video ID (e.g. "dQw4w9WgXcQ") or a full youtube.com / youtu.be URL

lang.description: Caption language code (e.g. "en", "fr", "pt-BR"). "en" also matches "en-US". Default: the video's default caption track. If the video has no track in this language the error lists the ones it has.

start_seconds.description: Skip segments that start before this many seconds (for paging through long videos). Default 0.

max_chars.description: Stop after this many characters of transcript text (default 50000, max 200000).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-youtube forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the youtube pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
